payload.text: Pre-trade limit-breach exposure safety (deliverable: limits-breach-detection). exposure_of is a pure, deterministic, total function over LimitMetric: it reads the aggregated net Greeks, vega ladder, gross concentration, and non-additive VaR/ES/StopLoss out of borrowed &NodeAggregate / &NonAdditiveExposure and returns the scalar exposure with no I/O and no mutation of any input. Determinism is the load-bearing safety property — pre-trade and post-trade checks (its four callers) measure the same metric against the same limit cap identically, so a breach can never be hidden by a non-reproducible reading. Pure (no WRITES edges); self-invalidates on change.
